record_scope_reconstruction: Reports concern both Grande and Petite Barrière between Goma and Gisenyi/Rubavu. Rwandan ministry calls this a screening slowdown while Congolese reporting describes entry/exit prohibition; contested date/occurrence status remains.

source_checks.finding: Original Ministry of Health statement August 1 says border open after morning traffic slowdown during reinforced screening.
Actualite explicitly names grande and petite barriers as two posts with entry and exit forbidden from Rwandan side that morning.
Original Appendix A E18 names Rubavu(Gisenyi)–Goma (La Corniche) and gives coordinate.

sites.name: Grande Barrière / La Corniche
sites.coordinate_method: Published AU-PIDA illustrative border-post coordinate, independently read in original report Appendix A
sites.precision: approximate crossing area; illustrative published marker, not surveyed gate
sites.evidence_note: Appendix A E18, printed p79 / PDF p81; longitude/latitude transcribed in lon,lat order. Report identifies crossing name but does not establish historic operation or exact obstruction.

phase_decisions.phase_applicability: Reports concern both Grande and Petite Barrière between Goma and Gisenyi/Rubavu. Rwandan ministry calls this a screening slowdown while Congolese reporting describes entry/exit prohibition; contested date/occurrence status remains. Current phase only: Reported temporary Goma–Gisenyi movement restriction on August 1; closure versus screening slowdown remains disputed.

date_scope_check.qualification_retained: This is a disputed same-day episode, not an adjudicated eight-hour physical shutdown. Congolese departures were reportedly exempt. No zero-hour or whole-day duration is calculated.
date_scope_check.review_limit: No dates, unknown reopenings, duration classifications or continuity assumptions changed by this geographic review.
